components.name: Alert
components.summary: An inline banner about the page or the shop: something the owner should know or act on, not the result of a form.

components.name: AppNav
components.summary: Navigation inside the signed-in app: a one-row top bar and a bottom tab bar on phones, a side rail from 1024px.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A surface box that groups related content: a list of products, a form, a chart.

components.name: Chart
components.summary: A bar chart that answers one question in its heading.

components.name: CodeInput
components.summary: Six separate boxes for the email verification code.

components.name: FormMessage
components.summary: The result of submitting a form, shown at the top of that form: an error that isn't about one field, or a success.

components.name: Logo
components.summary: The Daftr lockup: a notebook mark in a primary tile next to the word "Daftr" in Inter 600, -0.02em tracking, ink.

components.name: PageLayout
components.summary: How screens are laid out: the landing page grid and the centered auth column.

components.name: StatCard
components.summary: One headline number with its label, for the dashboard: Total stock value, Products running low, Sold this week.

components.name: StatusBadge
components.summary: The stock status of one product: an icon and a word in a pill.

components.name: TextField
components.summary: A labelled text input with optional hint and error.

components.name: TopNav
components.summary: The bar at the top of public pages: logo, a "Get started" button and, on phones, a menu.
